fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head and drove it by hand in a scratch git repo (fake rex on PATH, detach recorded via RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG): three change sets queued with rhiza run start --workflow plan. With no request, daemon --once --max-runs 3 started all three. With request 'Add exports' queued, daemon --once --max-runs 3 started two queued runs plus the request's plan run, leaving one start in starts.json; the next poll started it. With --max-runs 1 and a queued request, the queued start took the slot and the request stayed queued. Also ran TestScripts/daemon-queued-start-slot and daemon-request-slot: ok.
